review_evidence: Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus contains locally nameless and named calculi, beta/eta reduction, confluence, strong normalization, STLC/Fsub typing, and safety proofs.
Cslib/Foundations/Semantics/LTS and FLTS formalize executions, simulation, bisimulation, traces, divergence, termination, products, and categorical structure.

Cslib/Languages/CombinatoryLogic proves confluence and Church encodings; Cslib/Crypto and Cslib/Logics contain secret sharing, perfect secrecy, commitment, modal/propositional/linear logic, while Computability/Automata formalizes automata theory.
summary: Retain cslib as a broad formal computer-science library covering programming-language semantics, lambda calculi, process calculi, logic, cryptography, automata, relations, and algorithms.
